court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Family Court at Perambalur, HMOP No.65 of 2021
facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnised in 2018. The respondent filed for dissolution of marriage before the Family Court at Perambalur. The petitioner filed for restitution of conjugal rights before the Sub Court at Kallakurichi.

legal_principles.principle: Parents are duty bound to maintain their minor children.
legal_principles.held: The 2 year old child has to be taken care of by the father, who is the natural guardian and an earning member. The petitioner-wife is unemployed and therefore, the respondent-father has to maintain the child.

legal_principles.principle: Courts are bound to consider grant of Interim Maintenance in the interest of the minor children and to protect their livelihood.
legal_principles.held: For grant of Interim Maintenance to the minor children, no application is required. Even in the absence of any application, the Courts are bound to consider grant of Interim Maintenance in the interest of the minor children and to protect their livelihood.

legal_principles.principle: Remedy of maintenance is the measure of social justice as envisaged under the Constitution to prevent the wife and the children from falling into destitution and vagrancy.
legal_principles.held: Remedy of maintenance is the measure of social justice as envisaged under the Constitution to prevent the wife and the children from falling into destitution and vagrancy.

legal_principles.principle: Courts must act as a custodian of minor children when such children are neglected by either of the parents.
legal_principles.held: Court must act as a custodian of minor children, when such children are neglected by either of the parents.

outcome.final_order: The case was transferred from the file of the Family Court at Perambalur to the file of the Sub Court at Kallakurichi to be tried along with HMOP No.82 of 2022.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
use_for_drafting: transferring a case from one court to another
